0.content: Xiuhcoatl's last creation, in the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. It is a "Natlan Phlogistonization Array" that would burn everything and copy all its information into Phlogiston units, turning Natlan into a realm of pure primal flame. Living beings would die or become Phlogiston-based lifeforms, with draconic ones ruling the "new world." The Tzitzimimeh would then destroy any approaching Abyss through mutual annihilation. Its control hub was one of Xiuhcoatl's pupils, later the two Golden Entreaties. Activation needs three confirmations. Kukulkan led Little One there in 5.5 to activate it, but the sequence was cancelled.

1.content: Two white discs with golden patterns, made when Xbalanque's sword split Xiuhcoatl's control-hub pupil. Xbalanque and Kukulkan took one each and swore an oath of peace between humans and dragons ("Only the enemy cloaked in shadow shall not be forgiven"); Kukulkan says the alliance was meant to keep Huitzilopochtli from being activated. Xbalanque's half passed to Och-Kan, who hid it on the Tonatiuh, and Kukulkan hid his. Uniting both at the volcano wakes the array.

2.content: A mark on the horn of some Saurians born of Xiuhcoatl's line. It gives them ancient dragon power that their bodies cannot bear; it can drive them mad or kill them, and the Wayob and Night Kingdom reject them. Tradition said bringing both Golden Entreaties to the volcano would wash it away. Kukulkan admitted in 5.5 that he invented this legend to lure a human and a Blessed Saurian, the "Chosen of Dragons," to Huitzilopochtli. With proper guidance the power instead awakens the bearer's draconic wisdom, as it did for Little One. Och-Kan also carried the Blessing.

3.comment: Xiuhcoatl: Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
3.content: This is not Xiuhcoatl. During the 5.3 Archon Quest, Gosoythoth, the Reaper of the Abyss, pulled the remnant will of a dead dragon sovereign from the ley-line memories and used it as the base of a fabricated body. It fought Mavuika and the Traveler in this form and was defeated. The boss archive describes a once-dead dragon trapped forever in its last day, fury having consumed its reason.
